nodes.label: Find leads
nodes.does: Finds 10-20 UK Ltd candidates per session (skill: business-discovery)

nodes.label: Audit website
nodes.does: Records verified, evidenced website problems (skill: website-audit)

nodes.label: Qualify + score
nodes.does: Companies House, contact, suppression, score /100 (skill: lead-qualification)

nodes.label: Write email
nodes.does: Under-100-word email for score >= 70 + cleared, then a Gmail draft (skills: cold-email-writing, gmail-drafts)

nodes.label: George approves + sends
nodes.does: Per-recipient approval on the final text. Only George sends.

nodes.label: Classify replies
nodes.does: Classifies replies, suppresses opt-outs, records outcomes (skill: reply-classification)

nodes.label: Site enquiries
nodes.does: Matches formivanedigital.co.uk enquiries with source outreach:FD-#### back to the lead

nodes.label: Daily report
nodes.does: Writes the report and headline metrics (skill: outreach-reporting)

nodes.label: Self-improve
nodes.does: Decides A/B tests and proposes one prompt change, merged only by George

notes: 0 replies from 8 delivered emails (10 Nov batch): far too few sends to learn reply rates from yet. Until there are 15 or more per arm, the improver learns from George's edits to drafts.
Sending stays manual and per recipient (sales-agent/README.md approval matrix). Loops research and draft; they never send.
Website audits need open network access in the environment that runs them (see the 2026-11-15 setup report).
